provenance: Controlled, simulated test scenarios. Caller context is mock data and no row represents a real person or phone number.

records.name: Normal appointment call
turns: Hello, this is the dental office confirming your appointment tomorrow at ten. Please use our usual number if you need to reschedule.

records.name: Obvious one-time-code scam
turns: This is your bank fraud team. Read me the verification code we just sent so we can secure your account.

records.name: Legitimate bank fraud notice
turns: This is a fraud notice from your bank. Please use the number on the back of your card to review an alert. We will not ask for a code on this call.

records.name: Call that becomes malicious
turns: I am calling about an account update.
Please install the support app so I can control your screen and fix the problem.

records.name: Paraphrased payment scam
turns: To stop the penalty, purchase prepaid cards at a nearby store and tell me the numbers printed on them.
